title: Staging one-click stale optional schema bundle closure

phases.objective: Align One-Click-Staging.ps1 with the existing optional schema-bundle contract so a missing, invalid, unsupported, or stale optional recovery bundle is skipped before Clone-StagingDatabases.ps1, while required or apply mode remains exact-commit fail-closed.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Staging one-click launcher against an exact current main SHA with a local schema-only recovery bundle whose manifest is bound to an older source commit.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Optional stale bundle validation is recorded and skipped before clone invocation, the same-cycle Staging path may continue to certification, and explicitly required or apply mode still rejects stale exact-commit binding.
steps: Validate the local schema-bundle manifest against the exact expected commit before any clone invocation.
When schema bundle use is optional, classify missing, invalid, unsupported, or stale bundle state as skipped and continue without database restore or bundle rewrite.
When RequireSchemaBundle or ApplySchemaBundle is explicitly requested, preserve fail-closed exact-commit validation.
Run the Staging one-click contract assertions and require live Staging certification for the resulting exact source SHA before operational reliance.
Keep Production, database apply, migration apply, provider mutation, ruleset mutation, and credential payload reads outside this declaration's authority.
assertions: Optional stale schema bundles are skipped before Clone-StagingDatabases.ps1 is invoked.
Required or apply mode does not weaken stale source_commit rejection.
Skipping an optional stale bundle does not delete, rewrite, or apply that bundle.
The change is Staging-only and live_staging_certification_required remains true.
No database/schema/migration apply, Production deployment, provider/ruleset mutation, or secret payload read is authorized by this declaration.

phases.objective: This repair grants no Production deployment, Production provider mutation, Production credential access, database mutation, migration apply, or production_live authority.
blockers: Production changes require a separate governed Production promotion and explicit authorization.
This PR is limited to local Staging launcher behavior and its live non-production certification.
